subject.title: feat(media): polish voice transcript echo for review UX

question: Should existing `echoTranscript: true` installations automatically adopt reply-threaded microphone echoes, or should the new presentation and association be introduced only through an explicit compatibility transition?
rationale: The implementation intentionally changes behavior for a previously enabled persisted setting, and the repository policy treats default, config, and fallback behavior as upgrade-sensitive product decisions.

options.title: Preserve existing enabled behavior
options.body: Keep the current default delivery and formatting for existing enabled configurations until a maintainer-approved explicit transition is designed and tested.

options.title: Accept the UX transition
options.body: Adopt the new default and reply behavior for existing enabled configurations, with clear upgrade documentation and real-channel proof of supported and fallback paths.

recommendation.title: Preserve existing enabled behavior
recommendation.body: Keep the current default delivery and formatting for existing enabled configurations until a maintainer-approved explicit transition is designed and tested.

likelyOwner.reason: A current-main history pass is needed to identify the feature owner who can make the compatibility decision without relying on the external PR author alone.
